strategicSummary: In his 1979 documented games, Hikaru Nakamura exhibits a highly dynamic and versatile repertoire. As White, he frequently faces the Sicilian Defense as White (74 games, 76% win rate), faces the French Defense as White (28 games, 82% win rate), and faces the Caro-Kann Defense as White (24 games, 75% win rate). When steering the direction himself, he plays the Nimzo-Larsen Attack as White (46 games, 89% win rate), plays the Nimzowitsch-Larsen as White (28 games, 100% win rate), and plays the English Opening as White (23 games, 78% win rate). Engine evaluations show an average evaluation of +0.87 for White in specific Trompowsky lines. As Black, Hikaru Nakamura strongly prefers asymmetrical counterattacking structures. He most commonly plays the Modern Defense as Black (112 games, 87% win rate), plays the Sicilian Defense as Black (54 games, 65% win rate), and plays the French Defense as Black (38 games, 71% win rate). When opponents dictate the first move, he faces the English Opening as Black (38 games, 63% win rate). He also successfully plays the King's Indian Defense as Black (22 games, 82% win rate). Additional engine analysis notes an average evaluation of -0.31 for White in the Queen's Indian Accelerated and +1.53 for White in the St. George Defence.
